parsed.note_claim: The viral videos feature Australian singer Ky Baldwin, who is not related to the Bee Gees.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Are you related to the Bee Gees? No, I am no relation to the Bee Gees. After my short form video of How Deep is Your Love went viral a journalist put out an article that I was a grandson of one of them.
parsed.reason: Ky Baldwin's own website directly confirms he is not related to the Bee Gees and that his viral video led to false claims he was a grandson of a member.
